title: 1978 yil: Maykl Jordan maktab terma jamoasiga olinmagan

scenes.text: Seni rad etishsa, bu hali oxiri degani emas.
1978 yilda o'smir Maykl Jordan maktabning asosiy basketbol jamoasiga olinmadi.
scenes.keywords: high school basketball tryout players running

scenes.text: U kichik jamoada o'ynashda davom etdi va mashqni to'xtatmadi.
scenes.keywords: young player dribbling drills alone court

scenes.text: Keyinroq u NBAda olti marta chempion bo'ldi.
scenes.keywords: basketball player dunking arena slow motion

scenes.text: Ba'zan rad javobi eng kuchli turtki bo'ladi.
scenes.keywords: man running stairs at dawn training

scenes.text: Sen rad javobini nima deb bilasan: to'siqmi yoki turtkimi?

description: 1978 yilda Maykl Jordan Laney o'rta maktabining asosiy basketbol jamoasiga olinmagan va kichik jamoada o'ynagan. U mashqni davom ettirdi va keyinchalik NBAda olti marta chempion bo'ldi.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-07 (PASS; wording 'not selected for varsity / played junior varsity' is correct, 'cut from the team' would be misleading). Sports Illustrated Vault, 'Did this man really cut Michael Jordan?': https://vault.si.com/vault/2012/01/16/did-this-man-really-cut-michael-jordan (coach Pop Herring: placed on JV, not cut); Biography.com: https://www.biography.com/athletes/michael-jordan-life-before-nba-early-career ; Seattle Times 1998: https://archive.seattletimes.com/archive/19980111/2728054/the-unkindest-cut-of-all----dropping-of-michael-jordan-from-prep-varsity-remains-a-very-unpopular-topic ; six NBA titles with Chicago Bulls (1991-93, 1996-98): Britannica, Michael Jordan.
